facts.quote: An adult numbat requires up to 20,000 termites each day.

facts.quote: Because termites have a high water content Numbats obtain most of their water needs directly from their food

facts.quote: Unusual for marsupials, female numbats have no pouch

facts.text: Loví ho draví ptáci, plazi, zavlečené lišky a divoké kočky.
facts.quote: Known native predators include various reptiles and raptors, such as the carpet python, sand goanna, wedge-tailed eagle, collared sparrowhawk, brown goshawk, and the little eagle. They are also preyed upon by invasive red foxes and feral cats.
